devdoc.details: IntentSignalPolicy plus a default arbitrator, e.g. BondedArbitrator, so public intents can be released against locked stake. The signature covers the payer commitment, so only the gating service can vouch that the committed payer belongs to the taker. Configuration is immutable; governance changes it by selecting a new policy on the orchestrator.

validateSignalIntent(address,(address,ui.details: Verifies O3's gating message for the calling orchestrator, with the payer commitment appended.

returns.arbitrator: Address that may release, cancel and extend the intent; zero for none
returns.takerWhitelisted: Whether the intent settles without the settlement policy

devdoc.title: IntentSignalPolicyV2

validateSignalIntent(address,(address,ui.notice: Admits a signal; reverts to reject it before any funds are locked.

userdoc.notice: OrchestratorV4 signal policy. Admits a taker through the deposit's whitelist with the gating service's signature, and names the arbitrator of the group the taker signals through, or the default arbitrator when no group arbitrator applies.
